_meta.note: Real, verified official Indian civic authority sources — not placeholders. Hyderabad entries verified via live web research on 2026-10-12; the 7 additional metros and the national CPGRAMS fallback verified via live web research on 2026-10-22. On 2026-10-23, every one of the 13 city portals plus CPGRAMS was additionally live-verified by actually clicking through the real site in a real browser (not just fetching it) — see devpost/checklist.md Slice 11 for the full method. That pass replaced several links that had gone stale or were never reliable (GHMC's own FAQ page linked a typo'd dead URL; Chennai GCC's old redirect now 404s; BWSSB's own site times out) with real working alternatives found by navigating each site's own menus, and added filingSteps (concrete, step-by-step, written from actually using the form), helplinePhone (a number confirmed on the authority's own site), and a tutorialVideoUrl — a real video found by navigating directly to youtube.com and picking the most relevant genuine result (plain web search could not surface these; see checklist.md). Exact sub-page paths on government sites can change over time; each entry's officialDomain is the stable fallback if a deep link breaks.

national_fallback.authorityName: CPGRAMS — Centralized Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (Government of India)
national_fallback.sourceNote: CPGRAMS is the Government of India's official nationwide public grievance portal, connecting citizens to every state and central government department. Used when the reporter's location isn't one of CivicFix's specifically-verified metro cities (or no location was available) — this is the correct, honest general channel for anywhere in India, rather than guessing a specific local authority that hasn't actually been verified. Live-reverified 2026-10-23: the page loads and works.
filingSteps: Open the Lodge Grievance page — CPGRAMS now requires a registered account before you can file.
If you don't have one yet, use "Click here to register" and sign up with your mobile number and email.
Log in, then pick the ministry/department/state your issue falls under — for a local civic issue, look for your state government or "local body" category.
Fill in the grievance details and submit — you'll get a registration number by SMS/email to track status.
